caption: The drawing depicts a single ornate pitcher placed centrally on a plain, light-colored background. The pitcher is rendered in grayscale, with varying shades of gray and black used to convey depth, contours, and highlights, indicating a reflective surface. The body of the pitcher is rounded, with decorative raised patterns forming symmetrical, elongated heart-like shapes on both sides. The lip of the pitcher is wavy and uneven, with a prominent outward curve. The handle is elaborate, beginning at the rim with a structure resembling a branch or tendril that attaches to the body near the base of the rim and flows downward, ending in an organic, leaf-like flourish. The style of the handle and the decorative elements suggest a naturalistic or floral influence in the design. The background remains unadorned, focusing attention on the single object.
title: Silver Plated Water Pitcher
cluster: #19 — Ceramic Arts: Pottery, Stoneware, and Porcelain
